description.title: הודעה לגבי הזכות להגיש הסתייגות
description.summary: This table outlines the rights of a claimant regarding a decision on their claim. It details how to submit a reservation, and to whom (Harel Ombudsman, judicial bodies, etc.).
description.embed_passage: טבלה זו מתארת את הזכויות של תובע בנוגע להחלטה על תביעתו, במסגרת הליכי טיפול בתביעות של חברת הראל. היא מפרטת כיצד להגיש הסתייגות, ולמי (הומבסמן הראל, גופים שיפוטיים, וכו׳). ניתן להגיש הסתייגות להחלטה, להציג חוות דעת מומחה, לפנות להומבסמן הראל, או לגורמים אחרים כמו בתי משפט ונציבות שוק ההון ביטוח וחיסכון. הטבלה אינה חלה על הליך משפטי המתנהל בבית משפט. הזכויות כוללות הגשת הסתייגות, קבלת מידע על אופן הגשתה, ופנייה לגורמים רלוונטיים.
notable_values: entity: נציבות שוק ההון ביטוח וחיסכון

sketch:
h. Notice regarding the right to submit a reservation in regard to a decision
Any payment notice, notice of partial payment or rejection notice shall include a paragraph especially emphasizing, the plaintiff's following rights:
To submit a reservation in regard to a decision and the method of submitting a reservation if provided in the policy or the articles, including the plaintiff's right to file an expert opinion on his behalf.
To present his/her reservation to the Harel Ombudsman including the details of the Ombudsman and the manner in which he/ she can be contacted.
To present the reservation to other entities, including any judicial body or the Commissioner of Capital Markets, Insurance, and Savings with the Ministry of Finance.
■ The provisions of this paragraph shall not apply to a claim proceeding in court.

h. Notice regarding the right to submit a reservation in regard to a decision
Any payment notice, notice of partial payment or rejection notice shall include a paragraph especially emphasizing, the plaintiff's following rights:
To submit a reservation in regard to a decision and the method of submitting a reservation if provided in the policy or the articles, including the plaintiff's right to file an expert opinion on his behalf.
To present his/her reservation to the Harel Ombudsman including the details of the Ombudsman and the manner in which he/ she can be contacted.
To present the reservation to other entities, including any judicial body or the Commissioner of Capital Markets, Insurance, and Savings with the Ministry of Finance.
■ The provisions of this paragraph shall not apply to a claim proceeding in court.
